name: Takanashi Shizuku
source:
A third-year student at Seishin Academy and vice president of the archery club. She is popular with the younger girls, who see her as prince-like. But she herself is a girl to the core who loves cats and cute things. She has a [url=/c133968]boyfriend[/url] who is a member of the boy's archery club.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page03.html]official site[/url]]
